record.question: All of the following are reasons for why UTI (urinary tract infection) is more common in pregnancy, EXCEPT:
options: Dilatation of renal pelvis and ureters
record.explanation: Answer D: Increased cervical discharge. Pregnancy-related ureteral dilation, urinary stasis and incomplete emptying increase UTI risk; increased cervical discharge is not the urinary-tract mechanism described by obstetric guidance. Reference: https://www.acog.org/clinical/clinical-guidance/clinical-consensus/articles/2023/08/urinary-tract-infections-in-pregnant-individuals. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
